result.label: Arbitration Practice
result.definition: Arbitration, a form of alternative dispute resolution (ADR), is a way to resolve disputes outside the courts. The dispute will be decided by one or more persons (the "arbitrators", "arbiters" or "arbitral tribunal"), which renders the "arbitration award".

result.label: Arbitration Forum
result.definition: An Arbitration Forum is a specific type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Forum where disputes are resolved outside of the court system by a neutral third party or panel of experts.

result.label: Arbitration Event
result.definition: Arbitration Event refers to a specific type of Alternative Dispute Resolution (ADR) Event where a neutral third party is appointed to resolve a dispute between two or more parties outside of the court system.

result.label: Arbitration Award
result.definition: An arbitration award is a decision made by an arbitrator or panel of arbitrators to resolve a dispute between parties, which is binding and enforceable by law.

result.label: Arbitration Clause
result.definition: An arbitration clause is a provision in a contract that requires any disputes arising from the contract to be resolved through arbitration rather than through the court system.

result.label: Alternative Dispute Resolution Practice
result.definition: The use of methods such as mediation and arbitration to resolve a dispute instead of litigation.

result.label: Litigation Practice
result.definition: Matters that include official proceedings (e.g., court case, arbitration, mediation)

result.label: Dispute Proceeding Type
result.definition: Dispute Proceeding Type refers to the specific legal process used to resolve a conflict between parties, such as an investigation, alternative dispute resolution, administrative proceeding, civil court proceeding, or criminal court proceeding.
